entries.notes: `plane-services.sh` copies the three `.env.example` files and brings up `docker-compose-local.yml` (PostgreSQL, Valkey, RabbitMQ, MinIO, migrator, API on :8000) with `plane-compose.override.yml`, which unpublishes the database/cache host ports so they cannot collide with the other corpus containers. `turbo run dev --filter=web` builds the workspace packages first (they export `dist/`), then runs `react-router dev --port 3000`. `plane-setup.sh` symlinks `@tailwindcss/postcss` (a dependency of `packages/tailwind-config` only) into `apps/web/node_modules` because `apps/web/postcss.config.js` re-exports the shared config and postcss-load-config resolves plugin names from `apps/web`. Run with `--corpus-dir` outside this monorepo: `@react-router/dev` pre-bundles `react-router-dom` whenever `require.resolve` finds one from the app root, and a checkout nested under bippy picks up bippy's unrelated `react-router-dom@6`, which fails esbuild's optimizer against `react-router@7`.

entries.description: Blinko sign-in page (Vite 6 SPA served by the Express + vite-express backend on :1111: react-router-dom BrowserRouter with lazy routes, MobX stores, HeroUI, next-themes, i18next; Prisma over a local PostgreSQL container)
entries.install: bun install
entries.notes: Partial. The page mounts two React roots: react-dom for the sign-in form and a @react-three/fiber root for the shader gradient background (ShaderGradientCanvas, three.js WebGL that happy-dom cannot host), so the R3F root is opaque. `AppProvider` (an `observer`) maps `rootStore.providers`, which `initStore` pushes `ToastPlugin` into from a `useEffect`; the MobX model treats observability as transparent, so it never replays that reaction and the static side misses the `<provider key="ToastPlugin">` subtree. `Layout` calls `useTranslation` before its `/signin` early return; `fetch` now serves `public/locales/<lng>/translation.json`, so i18next-http-backend loads real resources and i18next replays its load -> `loaded` -> `changeLanguage` callback cascade across the forks of the detected language (about 18k `hasLanguageSomeTranslations` calls), which exhausts the step budget inside the render and leaves `Layout` unknown. HeroUI's Input/Checkbox/Button/Image run through @react-aria hooks and tailwind-variants slot functions whose props are runtime state (`useInput` focus/hover/filled, `tv()` reducers). framer-motion's `MotionConfig` and react-dev-inspector's `Inspector` are opaque pass-throughs. The `packageManager` field pins bun@1.2.8 but `bun install` resolves the lockfile with the ambient bun.
